p: blessed the people in the name: He called upon the Name of God, desiring him to prosper the people, and give good success to their beginnings.
record: That is, God's benefits to his people.
delivered first this psalm to thank: David gave them this Psalm to praise the Lord, signifying that in all our enterprises the Name of God should be praised and called upon.
deeds among the people: Of which this is the chiefest, that he has chosen himself a Church to call upon his name.
wondrous works: Who of his wonderful providence has chosen a few of the stock of Abraham to be his children.
judgments of his mouth: In overcoming Pharaoh, which judgments were declared by God's mouth to Moses.
chosen ones: Meaning by this that the promise of adoption only belongs to the Church.
few: Meaning, from the time that Abraham entered, to the time that Jacob went into Egypt for famine.
kings for their sakes: As Pharaoh and Abimelech.
anointed: My elect and those whom I have sanctified.
prophets no harm: To whom God declared his word and they declared it to their posterity.
idols: His strong faith appears in this, though all the world would follow idols, yet he would cleave to the living God.
Fear before him: Humble yourselves under the mighty hand of God.
heavens be glad: He exhorts the dumb creatures to rejoice with him in considering the greatness of the grace of God.
judge the earth: To restore all things to their estate.
glory in thy praise: He esteems this to be the chiefest happiness of man.
Amen: He wills all the people both in heart and mouth to consent to those praises.
them Heman and Jeduthun: With Zadok and the rest of the priests.
bless his house: Declaring that after our duty to God we are chiefly bound to our own house, for which as for all other things we should pray to God, and instruct our families to praise his Name.
